Author: n0way02
Name: PetFrenzy
Punchline: Animated Eorzea Tamagotchi with Live Multiplayer, 8-Player Co-op Mini-Bosses, Deviruchi, Job weapons & Wardrobe!
Description: Animated Eorzea Tamagotchi companion for FFXIV with Live Multiplayer & 8-Player Co-op Mini-Bosses! Hatch a Carbuncle, Fat Cat, Moogle, Namazu, Fluffy Shepherd, or Deviruchi, pet & gift friends' companions, invite nearby players to battle Level-Scaled Mini-Bosses with a shared Limit Break, level up to Lv.100 across ALL FFXIV content, equip all 43 Job weapons & tools, and customize Hats, Outfits, Wings, Weapon Auras, and RGB Colors.
Changelog: v1.1.1.1: Your floating pet now notifies you via a speech bubble whenever a new PetFrenzy update is available! Plus Deviruchi companion, 8-Player Co-op Mini-Boss Arena (Level Scaling, Boss Casts, + Heal & Shield, Shared Limit Break, Zone Invites), Live Petting/Gifting, 4-per-row Egg Nursery, What's New popup & Tutorial auto-scroll.
